summary: Model artifact + environment: vendor the student checkpoint and the torch dependency as an optional extra
description: Model home follows the general llm convention: checkpoints live under ~/programs/guru/<model-name>/ (like ~/programs/mistral, ~/programs/gemma4 etc.), NOT inside the repo — the repo carries only the pinned path + sha in config and the training card copy. student-3a2 has been seeded at ~/programs/guru/student-3a2/ (checkpoint + training-card.json, 2026-08-13). Versioning: new distills get a new dir (student-<arch><rev>); config points at exactly one. torch+transformers as an optional dependency group used only by derive_parallels; document the CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 pin and the CPU fallback (~7 min GPU / ~6 min 8-thread CPU int8 full corpus).
